bore_contact_observations.pair_state_rule: Only a complete pair-specific CF report with positive reported area is counted as a positive-area patch; force-bearing patch evidence further requires a finite nonzero CF vector. Zero/missing force by itself is not interpreted as open. CFN is not added to CF.

limits: The snapshot is a non-atomic immutable output prefix captured while the source process was running; it is not a terminal run.
Only accepted pilot.sta times are audited; no q value or inferred seating state is used.
Absent or incomplete pair reports remain unavailable, never replaced with zero.
Zero reported force/area does not prove that the physical gap stayed open.
These accepted states do not establish contact capacity, mechanical acceptance, response between states, or physical inspection.
CEL and FRD files were not opened or hashed; no native solve or CAD operation was performed.
